name: graphin-guide
description: Usage guidance for the graphin MCP server: skills for progressive-disclosure navigation (search → explore → read) and for the docs/wiki knowledge layer — knowledge sets over documentation sections, a project glossary, the propose-and-review queue, and the pre-flight gate that blocks delegation or edits until the knowledge for the work has been loaded. Plus a read-only explorer subagent that returns cited summaries instead of raw search output. Install alongside the graphin plugin.
